en.bdb: The ego of the Guru's progeny

verses.gurmukhi: ਬਾਲ ਜਤੀ ਹੈ ਸਿਰੀਚੰਦੁ ਬਾਬਾਣਾ ਦੇਹੁਰਾ ਬਣਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: baal jatee hai sireecha(n)dh baabaanaa dhehuraa banaiaa|

en.bdb: Sirichand ( the elder son of Guru Nanak) is celebate since childhood who has constructed the monument ( in memory) of Guru Nanak.

verses.gurmukhi: ਲਖਮੀ ਦਾਸਹੁ ਧਰਮ ਚੰਦ ਪੋਤਾ ਹੁਇ ਕੈ ਆਪੁ ਗਣਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: lakhamee dhaasahu dharam cha(n)dh potaa hui kai aap ganaiaa|

en.bdb: Dharam chand son of Laksami Das ( second son of Guru Nanak) also made display of his egotism.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮੰਜੀ ਦਾਸੁ ਬਹਾਲਿਆ ਦਾਤਾ ਸਿਧਾਸਣ ਸਿਖਿ ਆਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: ma(n)jee dhaas bahaaliaa dhaataa sidhaasan sikh aaiaa|

en.bdb: Guru Angad's one son Dasu was made to sit on the seat of Guruship and the second son Data also learnt to sit in the siddh posture i.e. both the sons of Guru Angad Dev were pretender Guru and during the time of third Guru Amar Das they tried their best to

verses.gurmukhi: ਮੋਹਣੁ ਕਮਲਾ ਹੋਇਆ ਚਉਬਾਰਾ ਮੋਹਰੀ ਮਨਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: mohan kamalaa hoiaa chaubaaraa moharee manaiaa|

en.bdb: Mohan (son of Guru Amar Das) got afflicted and Mohart (the second son) lived in a lofty house and started getting served by the people.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮੀਣਾ ਹੋਆ ਪਿਰਥੀਆ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਟੇਢਕ ਬਰਲੁ ਚਲਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: meenaa hoaa piratheeaa kar kar Teddak baral chalaiaa|

en.bdb: Prithichind (son of Guru Ram Das) came out as dissembling scoundrel and using his oblique nature spread his mental sickness all round.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਹਾਦੇਉ ਅਹੰਮੇਉ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਬੇਮੁਖੁ ਕੁਤਾ ਭਉਕਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: mahaadheau aha(n)meau kar kar bemukh kutaa bhaukaiaa|

en.bdb: Mahidev (another son of Guru Ram Das) was egotist who was also led astray.
They all were like bamboos who though lived near sandal – Guru, yet could not become fragrant.
